description: Send the Take Friday Off team a no-obligation call request for the person: their name, email, brand and what they want to talk about. Use it only when the person asks for a call or agrees to one, since it shares their name and email with the team. Returns a reference and a link (book_a_time) where they can pick a time themselves, with their name and email filled in.

brand.description: Their brand or organisation, if they have one

email.description: Their email address, for the reply

message.description: What they want to talk about: the product, where it is up to, the timing

revenue.description: Where the brand is today, in their words, e.g. "established, growing fast"

name: tfo_request_call

mailto.description: Only when the request could not be delivered: an email draft the person can send instead

reference.description: Quote it if the person follows up by email

test.description: True when the email is at a domain reserved for examples (example.com, .test): the request was checked but nothing was sent

title: Request a call
